headline: Aflac (AFL) Could Be 10% Above Fair Value On Shrinking Revenue Views
summary: Aflac (AFL) has attracted fresh attention as investors reassess the stock’s recent performance. headline: Humana Elects Paul Smith and Frederick Crawford to Board of Directors
summary: LOUISVILLE, Ky., July 29, 2026--Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) today announced that the Company’s Board of Directors has elected Paul Smith and Frederick Crawford as new Board members, effective immediately.
